title: Rav Salla Chasida
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman says that no halakhah or aggadah of his remains to him; he is mentioned only through his brother, as in Berakhot 5b and 29b: Rav Yehudah, the brother of Rav Salla Chasida (in Rav Huna’s time).
In Pesachim 73b: Rav Yosef son of Rav Salla Chasida.
